image_reproduction_scope: Exact decoded RGBA8 pixels and every surviving chunk/metadata after explicit privacy/time tEXt whitelist removal. Original raw PNG hashes remain bound; raw file-byte reproducibility is not asserted.

original_metadata_cleanup.method: Copy original PNG signature and every surviving complete chunk including CRC verbatim. Remove only whitelisted tEXt chunks. No IDAT recompression, pixel reencoding, colour conversion or image editing.

rerendered_metadata_cleanup.method: Copy original PNG signature and every surviving complete chunk including CRC verbatim. Remove only whitelisted tEXt chunks. No IDAT recompression, pixel reencoding, colour conversion or image editing.

sanitized_png_comparison.comparison_policy: Exact decoded noninterlaced RGBA8 channel bytes, dimensions/mode and every non-IDAT/nonvolatile chunk including colour profiles and File metadata. Only the listed tEXt time-field values may differ. This does not assert whole-PNG byte reproducibility.
